exercises.title: Requirements problems 1 — name the problem
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers lists six classic requirements problems. Name the problem behind each story from real student projects.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

# Requirements problems 1 — name the problem — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Insufficient user involvement
   - r1.k: Ambiguous requirements
   - r2.k: Creeping user requirements
   - r3.k: Gold plating
   - r4.k: Overlooked stakeholders
   - r5.k: Inaccurate planning
   Each story maps to one problem; note the difference between creeping requirements (the customer keeps adding) and gold plating (the team adds what nobody asked for).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Each story maps to one problem; note the difference between creeping requirements (the customer keeps adding) and gold plating (the team adds what nobody asked for).

Choose the right value for every row.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

o.s: The team built the canteen app from the manager’s ideas; no student was ever asked. — Đội xây app căng-tin theo ý quản lý; chưa hỏi sinh viên nào.
"The system shall support many payment methods" — the team built one, the client expected four. — "Hỗ trợ nhiều phương thức thanh toán" — đội làm một, khách mong bốn.
Each weekly meeting added "just one more small screen"; the release slipped by six weeks. — Mỗi tuần thêm "một màn hình nhỏ nữa"; bản phát hành trễ sáu tuần.
A developer added a dark-mode theme nobody asked for and missed the deadline of a real feature. — Dev thêm giao diện tối không ai yêu cầu, trễ hạn một tính năng thật.
The accounting office, which must approve refunds, discovered the system one week before go-live. — Phòng kế toán (phải duyệt hoàn tiền) biết tới hệ thống một tuần trước khi chạy.
The deadline was promised before anyone understood the requirements; the estimate was half the real effort. — Hạn chót được hứa trước khi hiểu yêu cầu; ước lượng chỉ bằng nửa công thật.

bang.giaiThich: Each story maps to one problem; note the difference between creeping requirements (the customer keeps adding) and gold plating (the team adds what nobody asked for).

mistakesJson.loi: Nhầm creeping requirements với gold plating.
Nhầm overlooked stakeholders với insufficient user involvement (bên bị quên không nhất thiết là người dùng).

exercises.title: Requirements problems 2 — the cost of late defects
exercises.problemHtml:
The "money slide" of Chapter 1: about half of all defects originate in requirements, and a requirements defect found late (in testing or in production) costs many times what it costs to fix during requirements work.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Requirements problems 2 — the cost of late defects — answer key

1. Why are requirements defects so expensive?Vì sao lỗi yêu cầu đắt như vậy?
   Answer: c) Because they surface late, after design, code and tests were built on the wrong requirement
   Everything built on the wrong requirement must be reworked.VI: Mọi thứ xây trên yêu cầu sai đều phải làm lại.

2. Which practice gives the cheapest defect removal?Thực hành nào gỡ lỗi rẻ nhất?
   Answer: a) Reviewing requirements with stakeholders before design starts
   A defect removed in the requirements phase costs a fraction of one removed later.VI: Lỗi gỡ ở giai đoạn yêu cầu chỉ tốn một phần nhỏ so với gỡ muộn.

3. Which is NOT a benefit of a high-quality requirements process?Điều nào KHÔNG phải lợi ích của quy trình yêu cầu chất lượng cao?
   Answer: c) No change requests will ever happen
   Changes still happen; a good process controls them instead of preventing them.VI: Thay đổi vẫn xảy ra; quy trình tốt kiểm soát chúng chứ không ngăn được.

# Requirements problems 4 — the practice that prevents each problem — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Identify user classes and work with product champions
   - r1.k: Baseline the requirements and run change control
   - r2.k: Review requirements and write them precisely
   - r3.k: Trace every requirement to a business objective
   - r4.k: Do a stakeholder analysis at the start
   - r5.k: Estimate from the size of the requirements and add contingency
   User classes and product champions (Ch.6) fight missing user input; baselines and change control (Ch.28) tame creeping requirements; reviews and writing guidelines (Ch.11, 17) remove ambiguity; tracing to business objectives exposes gold plating; stakeholder analysis (Ch.2) finds forgotten parties; requirement-based estimation improves plans (Ch.19).

exercises.title: Requirements problems 3 — compute the cost of finding requirement defects late
exercises.problemHtml:
A project found 40 requirements defects. Fixing one costs 1 unit if it is found during requirements, 5 units in design/coding, 10 units in system testing and 50 units after release. Without reviews, the defects were found like this: 4 during requirements, 12 in design/coding, 16 in system testing, 8 after release. With requirements reviews, the team expects 24 during requirements, 10 in design/coding, 5 in system testing, 1 after release.

Compute in COST: withoutReviews, withReviews (units), saving (units) and savingPct (saving ÷ withoutReviews × 100, 1 decimal).

Requirements

  • Numbers, not strings. savingPct rounded to 1 decimal.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Một dự án có 40 lỗi yêu cầu. Sửa một lỗi tốn 1 đơn vị nếu tìm thấy lúc làm yêu cầu, 5 lúc thiết kế/code, 10 lúc system test và 50 sau phát hành. Không review: 4 lỗi tìm lúc yêu cầu, 12 lúc thiết kế/code, 16 lúc system test, 8 sau phát hành. Có review yêu cầu: dự kiến 24, 10, 5, 1. Tính COST: withoutReviews, withReviews, saving, savingPct.

Yêu cầu

  • Là số, không phải chuỗi. savingPct làm tròn 1 chữ số.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: 624 − 174 = 450 units saved (72.1%). Eight defects found after release cost more (400) than all the other phases together — that is why requirements reviews pay for themselves.

mistakesJson.loi: Chia cho withReviews thay vì withoutReviews.
Quên rằng lỗi sau phát hành tốn 50 đơn vị — chính nó tạo phần lớn chi phí.
